_note: Hand-computed schedule slots (specs/002 research R1, ADR-0014) for ontime_sample.csv over 2026-01-05..2026-01-14 (10 days), window 30 min. Times are local minutes after midnight at the origin. A join's change date is the first day on the later schedule.

explanations.WN: WN renumbers daily (1001/2001, 1002/2002) but keeps the schedule: one slot per leg, each flight number on half the days.
explanations.F9: F9 300 and F9 302 are 20 min apart (inside the window) on every day: the cluster is split by order within the day into two slots.
explanations.UA-CMH-ORD: UA7002 leaves 08:00 on d1-d6 and 09:00 on d7-d10, when it shares 09:00 with UA7000. The 09:00 cluster is split by rank; on d1-d6 UA7000 goes to the sub-slot that carries its own number. UA7002's 08:00 days end on d6 and its 09:00 days start on d7 with the same flight number: joined, change on 2026-01-11. Reference = 5th of the sorted 10 days = 480.
explanations.UA-ORD-DEN: UA7003 leaves 09:00 on d1-d4 and 10:00 on d5-d10; UA7001 leaves 10:20 on odd days and 14:30 on even days. The 10:00/10:20 cluster splits into UA7003 (10:00) and UA7001 (10:20); UA7003's two parts are joined (change on 2026-01-09, reference 600). UA7001's two times alternate, so they overlap in date and are not joined: two slots at 50%.
explanations.AA-ORD-DEN: AA1508 10:00 (d1-d5) and AA1510 10:30 (d1-d6) are exactly the window apart, so one cluster split by rank; on d6, AA1510 goes to its own sub-slot.
explanations.AA-ORD-SAN: AA1506 12:20 and AA1504 12:30 every day: split by rank into two slots.
